name: Receipts Engine
description: Parses a CV into numbered lines, extracts the requirements from a job posting, matches each requirement to the CV lines that evidence it, and rewrites bullets and cover letters that a deterministic verifier has proved are grounded in the CV.
_comment: `tool_id` here is the local-dev id: `anna-app dev` spawns `uv run --project . <tool_id>`, so it must equal a [project.scripts] key in pyproject.toml. At publish time `anna-app apps publish` mints the real id and substitutes every `bundled:receipts-engine` reference; run `python scripts/set-tool-id.py apply --tool <minted>` only if you pin an id by hand. `scripts/set-tool-id.py status` checks that this file, pyproject.toml and the UI agree.
